source.note: Every row below was an open Dependabot alert on that date. Six were open when this table was first written; two more surfaced when GitHub re-evaluated the dependency graph after the six were closed, which is why the count in this file is 8 and not 6. The table is not a copy of the GitHub Advisory Database: it is the subset that was open against this lockfile, and it exists so test_dependency_advisories.py can fail if a resolution ever moves back inside one of these ranges. A row is removed when the advisory stops applying, never because the alert went quiet.

advisories.summary: Path traversal / arbitrary file read via the redirect mock
advisories.fixedBy: vitest 5.0.5, whose bundled @vitest/mocker is the same version -- the two move together, so an override of one without the other is not a fix

advisories.summary: Code injection via unauthenticated manual mock registration
advisories.fixedBy: vitest 5.0.5; this is the row that sets the real floor on the axis, at 4.1.12 rather than 4.1.11

advisories.summary: Path traversal / arbitrary file read via the redirect mock
maxTotalMergeKeys does not limit CPU use for empty merge sources
advisories.fixedBy: js-yaml 4.3.2, reached inside @eslint/eslintrc's existing ^4 range -- no override, because the range already allowed the patch

advisories.summary: Quadratic-time expansion of the {a,b} rewrite causes CPU denial of service
advisories.fixedBy: brace-expansion 1.1.21 under minimatch 3, again inside the existing ^1.1.7 range; the 2.x and 5.x lines were never affected

advisories.summary: Event-loop denial of service through indexed source-map section offsets
advisories.fixedBy: source-map-js 1.2.2, inside postcss's and magicast's existing ^1.2.1 ranges

advisories.summary: Path traversal via a crafted non-string locale name
advisories.fixedBy: moment 2.31.0, inside pg-mem's existing ^2.27.0 range -- no override, same as the first three

advisories.summary: Denial of service via globparts amplification
advisories.fixedBy: an explicit pnpm.overrides pin to ^11.0.1, which is the one override in this file and the only advisory here with no patched version inside any declared range: eslint 9 asks for ^3.1.2, @eslint/eslintrc for ^3.1.5, @eslint/config-array for ^10.2.4 and typescript-eslint for ^10.2.6, all below 11.0.1. The override was measured before it was trusted -- the set of files eslint lints is byte-identical at 366 files on minimatch 3 and on 11, and pnpm check is green -- and the advisory itself carries no CVSS score (0.0), which is recorded rather than read as 'harmless'
